about: One row per system in Granny (the host game) that the mod adds to or changes. hookTarget (the real class or method in the game's code) stays null until Granny's install has been inspected on the PC. Route is the intended approach, not yet verified.

rows.whatItDoes: Fire, reload and slot-switch keys run the weapon rows
rows.route: in-game mod plugin patches the player controller update

rows.whatItDoes: Raycast from the camera on each shot; damages Granny when hit
rows.route: mod adds its own raycast, no game code change

rows.whatItDoes: Gives Granny a health value (design: 300). At zero she goes down and stays down for the rest of the run
rows.route: mod adds a health component on Granny and disables her AI state machine at zero

rows.whatItDoes: Each shot raises a noise event at the player's position with the weapon's noiseRadiusMeters, so Granny investigates
rows.route: reuse whatever noise or hearing input the game already has for dropped items and doors

rows.whatItDoes: Places each weapon and its ammo at fixed spots in the house; picking up equips it
rows.route: mod spawns pickup objects at coordinates read from the house scene

rows.whatItDoes: Finds the player's CS2 folder from Melty's {game:counter-strike-2} path, opens its VPK archives and loads the sounds and weapon models the rows name
rows.route: VPK reader library inside the mod; sounds first, models second

rows.whatItDoes: Shows magazine and reserve ammo for the held weapon
rows.route: mod draws its own small overlay
